apierror-invalidusername: Error message returned by the API when someone tried to change the profile of a non-existing user.
userprofilev2-user-locked: Warning message shown on profile of a user profile when their account is locked via CentralAuth
userprofilev2-selectavatar: Button text for uploading an avatar
userprofilev2-avatarchanged: Text that displays in a bubble notification when an avatar has been successfully changed.
apierror-forbidden: Error message returned by the API when a user doesn't have permission to change an avatar.
apierror-nofile: Error message returned by the API when someone tried to change an avatar but no file was sent with the request.
apierror-ratelimited: Error message returned by the API when someone is rate limited from uploading images.
userprofilev2-avatardeleted: Message shown in bubble notification when an avatar has been successfully deleted.
aboutme: Label text for "about me" input box
discord: Label text for "Discord username" input box
twitter: Label text for "Twitter username" input box
mastodon: Label text for "Mastodon username" input box
aboutmeplaceholder: Placeholder text for the "about me" input box
showglobalgroups: Label text for checkbox that toggles whether global groups are shown on a profile.
showglobaleditcount: Label text for checkbox that toggles whether global edits are shown on a profile.
showglobalgroupshelp: Help text for checkbox that toggles whether global groups are shown on a profile.
showglobaleditcounthelp: Help text for checkbox that toggles whether global edits are shown on a profile.
mastodonhelp: Help text for Mastodon username input.
twitterhelp: Help text for Twitter username input.
discordhelp: Help text for Discord username input.
aboutmehelp: Help text for "about me" input box.
